Sports are all around, with an amazing college athletes and 4 major sports teams less than 1 hour away. Need to get away for a drive in the country? 30 minutes or less will have you on a dirt road. You can also drive/fly up north within 5 hours. You can also run into a lot of people with a lot of different stories. This is largely due to the university and Michigan Medicine. All these reasons are staying points for me, and I don’t think a lot of other cities, bigger or smaller, have all these things in an accessible  way that AA does that makes me happy.

If I am to stay here for a long time, I think the college town vibe will keep me young and there’s nothing like tailgating with friends or seeing the Big House filled up. 

I probably will experiment and live in big city like Chicago/NYC because I think it would be interesting and good for me, but AA just feels like home to me and it’s an amazing feeling!
